name: segmently-launch-assistant
description: Customer-facing Segmently launch assistant for CLI, browser walkthroughs, verification, and offline paywall unit economics.

interface.shortDescription: Launch funnels with CLI and browser guidance.
interface.longDescription: Guides customer-facing agents through Segmently funnel launch workflows, delegating CLI actions, browser walkthroughs, and verification to bundled skills, and answers paywall unit-economics questions (price, trial, store vs web fees, which experiment first) offline with the bundled segmently-unit-economics skill.
defaultPrompt: Show me what is left before my Segmently funnel can go live.
Change a Segmently screen setting and verify it.
Is a $19.99 monthly worth launching on the web?
